Interface ModelExecutor

All Known Implementing Classes:
Llama, Qwen
public interface ModelExecutor
Low-level execution surface used by InferenceEngine.

Continuous batching uses bind(int[], int)/prefill(int, int[], int)/decodeStep(int[], int[], int[]) instead of monolithic LanguageModel.generate(int[], int, double, double, boolean, long, GenerationListener). Offline callers may still use LanguageModel.generate(int[], int, double, double, boolean, long, GenerationListener).

    • prefill

      Tensor prefill(int requestId, int[] prompt, int prefixLen)
      Prefills the unbound suffix of a prompt (activates this request alone).
      Parameters:
      requestId - request id.
      prompt - full prompt tokens.
      prefixLen - cached prefix to skip (from prefixLen(int)).
      Returns:
      last-position logits shaped [1, vocab] (caller owns).

    • prefillChunk

      default Tensor prefillChunk(int requestId, int[] prompt, int from, int to)
      Prefills prompt[from, to) (chunked Continuous Batching). Returns last-token logits only when to == prompt.length.
      Parameters:
      requestId - request id.
      prompt - full prompt tokens.
      from - inclusive start position in the prompt.
      to - exclusive end position.
      Returns:
      logits [1, vocab] when the prompt is fully prefilled; otherwise null.

    • warmPrefix

      default void warmPrefix(int requestId, int[] prompt, int prefixLen)
      After a radix KV prefix hit of length prefixLen, restores any non-KV state required before suffix prefill may start at prefixLen.

      Default is a no-op (pure Transformer KV reuse). Hybrid models that keep DeltaNet (or similar) state must replay or restore that state here when prefix reuse is enabled.

      Parameters:
      requestId - request id from bind(int[], int).
      prompt - full prompt tokens.
      prefixLen - page-aligned matched prefix (>= 0).

    • prefillMultimodal

      default Tensor prefillMultimodal(int requestId, QwenVlProcessor.ProcessedMultimodal multimodal, int from, int to)
      Prefills a multimodal prompt using vision embeds + interleaved mRoPE. Default throws; Qwen overrides.
      Parameters:
      requestId - request id.
      multimodal - preprocess result.
      from - inclusive start (normally 0; prefix reuse disabled for VL).
      to - exclusive end.
      Returns:
      logits when to == inputIds.length, else null.

    • decodeStep

      Tensor decodeStep(int[] requestIds, int[] lastTokens, int[] positions)
      One decode step for an active set (same or mixed positions; engine may cohort by position). Tokens are [B] last tokens; positions are the write index for each row.
      Parameters:
      requestIds - active KV request ids (order = batch).
      lastTokens - token id per request.
      positions - absolute position per request.
      Returns:
      logits [B, vocab] (caller owns).

    • speculateStep

      default int[][] speculateStep(int[] requestIds, int[] lastTokens, int[] positions, int numDrafts, double temperature, double topp)
      One speculative MTP round for a uniform draft depth.

      Default throws; Qwen overrides when MTP weights are loaded.

      Parameters:
      requestIds - active KV request ids (order = batch).
      lastTokens - last committed token per request.
      positions - absolute position of lastTokens[i] (write of next is +1).
      numDrafts - draft depth (same for every request in this call).
      temperature - sampling temperature (verify).
      topp - nucleus top-p (verify).
      Returns:
      accepted token ids per request (each length >= 1; caller owns arrays).

    • speculateStep

      default int[][] speculateStep(int[] requestIds, int[] lastTokens, int[] positions, int numDrafts, double[] temperatures, double[] topps)
      Same as speculateStep(int[], int[], int[], int, double, double) with per-request sampling parameters, so a cohort whose requests sample differently is still verified in one batched forward. The default delegates to the scalar overload when every request shares the same parameters and otherwise runs the requests one at a time.
      Parameters:
      requestIds - active KV request ids (order = batch).
      lastTokens - last committed token per request.
      positions - absolute position of lastTokens[i] (write of next is +1).
      numDrafts - draft depth (same for every request in this call).
      temperatures - per-request sampling temperature (verify).
      topps - per-request nucleus top-p (verify).
      Returns:
      accepted token ids per request (each length >= 1; caller owns arrays).

    • idleDecodeGraphPrefetch

      default void idleDecodeGraphPrefetch()
      Advances pending decode-graph prefetch when the scheduler is idle but KV remains bound (e.g. between continuous-batching waves).
